metadata.description: Operator email for Relio failure alerts. Empty (default) deploys no action group and no alert rule.

variables.failureQuery:
let relioEvents = datatable(EventId:int, EventName:string) [
    9001, 'RelioUnhandledHttpFailure',
    9002, 'RelioCircuitFailure',
    9003, 'RelioReminderJobFailure',
    9004, 'RelioProductMetricsRetentionFailure',
    9005, 'RelioBackupFailure'
];
AppServiceConsoleLogs
| where ResultDescription contains '"EventId":90'
| extend entry = parse_json(ResultDescription)
| extend EventId = toint(entry.EventId), ExceptionType = tostring(entry.State.ExceptionType)
| join kind=inner relioEvents on EventId
| project TimeGenerated, EventName, ExceptionType

properties.description: Unhandled HTTP errors, interactive circuit failures, background job and backup failures (event ids 9001-9005). See docs/operations/monitoring.md.

metadata.description: Object id of a person who may manage Key Vault secrets. Leave empty to grant nobody (staging does when no operator id is configured).
